SaaS & startups / B2B SaaS

Product-led growth with a sales and success team behind it

For B2B SaaS teams selling to Indian SMBs, mid-market companies or global buyers. We connect PostHog, Stripe or Razorpay, HubSpot or Salesforce and your help desk so trials, product-qualified accounts, renewals and account health each have a rule, an owner and a record.

The challenge

What makes b2b saas different.

01

Good-fit trial users go cold because nobody sees their usage until the trial has ended.

02

Account executives get raw signup lists without context, so outreach arrives late and reads as generic.

03

Renewal risk shows up as a cancellation email, even though seat usage and logins had been falling for weeks.

04

Indian SMB customers pay by card or UPI Autopay, and failed mandate renewals turn into involuntary churn.

05

Support answers the same setup and integration questions while API and billing issues wait in the same queue.

Where automation helps

Practical uses for b2b saas.

01

Workspace activation tracking

Define activation at the workspace level, such as a connected data source plus invited teammates, and guide each workspace toward the step it is missing.

02

Product-qualified account handoff

Route accounts that cross agreed usage and fit thresholds to the right account executive with a usage brief and a booking link, instead of a weekly list export.

03

Trial and renewal notices

Send trial-ending and renewal reminders that state the date, the amount including any GST and how to cancel, and pull sales into high-fit trials before they lapse.

04

Account health for customer success

Combine seat utilization, feature depth, ticket volume and survey responses into an account health view that alerts the owner when an account turns.

05

Docs-grounded support for setup questions

Answer configuration and API questions from current docs with citations, and hand billing, security and data requests to people with a summary.

06

Mandate-aware payment recovery

Bring customers back to re-authenticate or switch payment method when an India-issued card or UPI renewal fails, instead of relying on blanket retries.

Discover & evaluateStandard3–5 weeks

Product-qualified lead and demo routing

Demo requests and trial accounts that cross agreed usage and fit thresholds reach the right account executive with a usage brief and a booking link, while low-fit signups stay in self-serve journeys.

B2B SaaS · AI-first products

Open the automation blueprint

The problem

Signups and demo requests land in a shared inbox or CRM list without context. Account executives cannot tell a serious team evaluating the product from a student testing it, so good accounts wait while time goes to poor fits.

Trigger

A demo form submission, or a PostHog event showing a trial workspace has crossed the agreed product-qualified threshold, such as a connected integration plus several active teammates or credits nearing the plan limit.

How it runs

  • Deduplicate the person and company against HubSpot or Salesforce and attach the PostHog group for the workspace.
  • Enrich business domains with firmographics from Apollo or Clay; personal-email signups are not enriched and reach sales only if they ask to be contacted.
  • Score fit and usage against written rules owned by revenue operations, and store the reason code with the score.
  • Assign an owner by territory, segment or round robin, create the deal or task, and offer qualified requesters an instant booking link.
  • Send booking confirmation and reminders by email, or by WhatsApp where the requester opted in.
  • Post an AI-drafted brief to the owner in Slack with usage highlights, company context and suggested discovery questions, linked to source records.
  • Log the outcome and review routing accuracy with sales every week.

Human checkpoint

The account executive reads the brief and decides whether, when and how to reach out. Revenue operations approves scoring rules and routing changes, and no sales email is sent automatically.

Systems it connects

  • Product database
  • Calendar booking (HubSpot Meetings or Calendly)

Uses business contact details, company firmographics and workspace-level usage aggregates; raw event streams stay in PostHog. The privacy notice covers sales follow-up, enrichment is limited to business domains, and CRM retention follows the client's policy. Only sales and revenue operations roles can see scores.

What we deliver

  • Routing workflow with owner assignment and booking links
  • Slack account brief template
  • Weekly routing accuracy report

  • Meeting show rate
  • Win rate on routed opportunities

Sign up & activateStandard3–4 weeks

Event-driven onboarding and activation journeys

In-product tips, email, push and opt-in WhatsApp messages triggered by what each new user or workspace has and has not done, stopping the moment the activation milestone is reached.

B2B SaaS · Consumer & mobile apps

Open the automation blueprint

The problem

Onboarding drips run on a fixed calendar, so users who already succeeded keep getting tips and users stuck on step two get nothing specific. Product teams cannot see which message helped and which only added noise.

Trigger

A signup event in PostHog followed by the absence of the next onboarding event within an agreed window, for example no data source connected within a day of creating a workspace, or no completed first session in a consumer app.

How it runs

  • Agree the activation milestone and the three to five steps before it, and map each step to a PostHog event and cohort.
  • Write one message per stuck step: an in-product checklist item, a Resend or Brevo email, a mobile push, or an approved WhatsApp template for users in India who opted in.
  • Check frequency caps, quiet hours and channel preferences before each send, and stop the journey as soon as the milestone event fires.
  • Keep a holdout group so the team can compare activation with and without the messages.
  • Report activation by cohort, step drop-off and opt-outs in a weekly view for the product lead.

Human checkpoint

The product or growth lead approves every message, cap and stop rule before launch and reviews the weekly cohort view. Changes to the activation definition need product and revenue sign-off.

Tools

PPostHognn8nRResendBBrevoWBWhatsApp Business Platform

Systems it connects

  • Product database
  • Firebase Cloud Messaging or OneSignal
  • In-app messaging (Intercom or custom)

Data & consent

Uses event names, timestamps and account identifiers, not the content users create or upload. Promotional messages respect consent and opt-outs; onboarding messages stay within service purposes. Accounts known to belong to users under 18 are excluded from behavior-based journeys, in line with the DPDP Act's limits on tracking children.

What we deliver

  • Activation milestone and event specification
  • Message matrix with caps and stop rules
  • Live journeys with a holdout group
  • Weekly activation cohort view

How we measure it

  • Activation rate within the agreed window
  • Step-level drop-off
  • Message opt-out rate
  • Time to first value

Convert & payStandard2–4 weeks

Trial-to-paid nudges with clear renewal notices

Trial reminders tailored to what each account actually used, stating the conversion date, the price including any GST and the cancellation route plainly, with high-fit trials flagged to sales.

B2B SaaS · Consumer & mobile apps

Open the automation blueprint

The problem

Every trial user gets the same countdown emails. People who never reached value are pushed to pay, people who did are not reminded what they set up, and some trials convert without a clear notice, which India's dark patterns guidelines list as a SaaS billing dark pattern.

Trigger

Stripe's customer.subscription.trial_will_end event (sent three days before the trial ends), an App Store or Google Play trial status change, or a usage event showing the account hit a paid-plan limit.

How it runs

  • Join the trial's plan and dates from Stripe with PostHog usage to place the account in one of a few agreed states, such as activated, partly activated or inactive.
  • Send the reminder for that state, naming the conversion date, the amount including any GST and a one-step cancellation link, or the store's subscription settings for App Store and Google Play trials.
  • Offer inactive trials help or an extension instead of a payment push, and show activated ones a summary of what they set up.
  • Create a sales task for high-fit B2B trials so an account executive can offer a call before the trial ends.
  • Log every notice sent against the subscription so support can answer renewal questions.

Human checkpoint

The revenue lead approves pricing copy, extension rules and any discount beyond the agreed band. Your legal or compliance owner reviews any trial that collects a card or mandate upfront, since India's guidelines treat forcing payment details for a free subscription as a subscription trap.

Tools

SStripePPostHognn8nRResendHHubSpot

Systems it connects

  • Stripe Billing or Razorpay Subscriptions
  • App Store Connect
  • Google Play Console

Data & consent

Uses plan, trial dates, billing status and aggregate usage only; card details stay with the payment provider. Notices are service messages tied to the subscription, and the log of notices sent is kept for the life of the subscription plus the agreed record period.

What we deliver

  • Trial state definitions
  • Notice templates with price, date and cancellation link
  • Sales task rules for high-fit trials
  • Notice log linked to each subscription

How we measure it

  • Trial-to-paid conversion
  • Refund requests in the first billing period
  • Trial extensions granted and later converted
  • Cancellation reasons by trial state

Use, match & get helpStandard4–6 weeks

Docs-grounded support assistant with human handoff

An assistant that answers how-to questions only from your current docs and changelog, cites its sources, says it is an AI, and hands billing, account, security and uncertain cases to a person with a summary.

B2B SaaS · Marketplaces & platforms · AI-first products

Open the automation blueprint

The problem

The same setup and how-to questions fill the queue, so urgent bugs and billing problems wait. Generic chatbots answer from stale or invented information and trap users who need a person.

Trigger

A new conversation or ticket in the help desk or in-app chat.

How it runs

  • Classify intent, product area, urgency, plan tier and language.
  • Retrieve passages from approved help center articles, API docs, the changelog and known-issues pages, indexed with LlamaIndex in Qdrant.
  • Answer how-to questions with cited links and an AI disclosure; when no approved source supports an answer, say so and offer a person.
  • Route refunds, billing disputes, account access, security reports, data deletion requests and low-confidence cases to the human queue with a summary.
  • Turn reproducible bug reports into Jira issues with steps, environment and affected accounts.
  • Review a weekly sample of conversations and unanswered questions to fix docs and retrieval.

Human checkpoint

Support agents own every refund, account change, security report and data request. The support lead approves which sources the assistant may use and reviews the weekly sample before its scope expands.

Tools

Systems it connects

  • Help center and API docs

Data & consent

Ticket text can contain personal data and secrets, so API keys, card numbers and passwords are redacted before model calls. Model providers are configured not to train on the data where that option exists. Conversation retention follows the help desk policy, and users see an AI disclosure at the first message.

What we deliver

  • Approved knowledge source list and index
  • Assistant with disclosure, citations and handoff
  • Escalation rules and agent summary format
  • Weekly quality review sheet

How we measure it

  • First response time
  • Resolution time
  • AI escalation rate
  • Groundedness of cited answers
  • Satisfaction on AI-handled conversations

Renew & retainStandard4–6 weeks

Churn-risk alerts from usage drops

A weekly account health model spots falling usage, seat drops, departed champions and support spikes ahead of renewal, and gives the customer success owner an evidence-linked brief and a task.

B2B SaaS

Open the automation blueprint

The problem

Customer success learns about risk when the cancellation arrives. Usage lives in PostHog, renewal dates in Stripe or the CRM and complaints in the help desk, so nobody sees the whole account in time to help.

Trigger

A weekly scheduled run, plus an immediate run when an account admin is deactivated or a detractor survey response arrives.

How it runs

  • Model weekly account health in BigQuery with dbt from PostHog usage, Stripe plan and renewal data, CRM ownership and help desk volume.
  • Flag accounts whose key-feature usage, active seats or logins fall below their own baseline, or whose champion has left.
  • Draft a short brief with the likely reasons and links to the underlying charts and tickets.
  • Create a HubSpot or Salesforce task for the owner and post the alert in the customer success Slack channel.
  • Record the action taken and the outcome, and review signal precision every month.

Human checkpoint

The customer success manager decides whether to call, run a training session, involve product or propose commercial terms. Discounts and contract changes need revenue lead approval.

  • CRM or customer success platform

Renew & retainStandard3–4 weeks

Failed-payment recovery and mandate-aware dunning

Payment failures are classified by cause and channel: India-issued card and UPI renewals get a link to authenticate or switch payment method, store subscriptions follow App Store and Google Play rules, and key accounts reach a person before any downgrade.

B2B SaaS · Consumer & mobile apps

Open the automation blueprint

The problem

Renewals fail for expired cards, insufficient funds or missing authentication. Stripe attempts India-issued card renewals only once, App Store and Google Play run their own retries, and generic reminder emails do not tell customers what they actually need to do.

Trigger

Stripe invoice.payment_failed or invoice.payment_action_required events, a Razorpay subscription.pending or subscription.halted event, or App Store and Google Play notifications for billing retry, grace period or account hold.

How it runs

  • Classify the failure by provider, card origin, decline reason and whether authentication or a mandate is missing.
  • For India-issued cards and UPI Autopay, follow each provider's retry rules and send a hosted link to authenticate or switch payment method by email and, where the customer opted in, an approved WhatsApp utility template.
  • For international cards, let Stripe Smart Retries run and time reminders around the retry schedule.
  • For App Store and Google Play subscriptions, show an in-app prompt to update payment in the store and never ask for card details in the app.
  • Apply the agreed grace period through a feature flag on the account, then move it to the free plan rather than deleting data.
  • Alert the account owner and finance in Slack before a high-value B2B account is downgraded.

Human checkpoint

Finance owns the grace-period and downgrade policy. Customer success decides manual extensions or invoice payment for key accounts, and this workflow never deletes account data.

Tools

Systems it connects

  • App Store Server Notifications
  • Google Play real-time developer notifications

Uses payment status, decline codes, plan and contact details; card data never leaves the payment provider. Recovery messages are transactional and avoid threatening language. Payment event logs are kept for the period finance and tax records require.

What we deliver

  • Recovery messages for each failure case
  • Grace-period and downgrade logic
  • Recovery dashboard by cause and provider

How we measure it

  • Recovered renewals as a share of failures
  • Involuntary churn
  • Time from failure to recovery
  • Key accounts downgraded without prior contact
